Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1920

Report for the Year 1920 and Budget for the Year 1921
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1921

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the figures printed on the fire-loss chart, the fold-out list of fires and the census fold-out, the staff list, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs, the weather diagram, maps and the graphs without printed figures are not. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense pages and fold-outs by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (23 cells). Chapters follow the printed contents (three page series, 1A–302A, 1B–56B and 1C–128C, as printed).
